items.title: File Chatham County business personal property return
items.description: Georgia business personal property returns (Form PT-50P) are due to the county between January 1 and April 1 for property held on January 1; a 10% penalty applies to unreported property if the return is late. Returns filed on April 1 must be postmarked that day; metered mail dates are not accepted. Personal property bills are due by November 15.

note: Unincorporated-area lodging tax and business license rules were not found; Chatham's cities (Savannah, Pooler, Port Wentworth) run their own.

items.title: File Cherokee County business personal property return
items.authority: Cherokee County Board of Tax Assessors
items.description: Georgia business personal property returns (Form PT-50P) are due to the county between January 1 and April 1 for property held on January 1; a 10% penalty applies to unreported property if the return is late. The county posts the current-year form on its tax assessor documents page.

items.title: Obtain the Cherokee County occupation tax certificate
items.description: Any business, trade, profession or occupation in unincorporated Cherokee County must register with the county and obtain a commercial occupation tax certificate, one for each location or branch. Fees start at $30 plus per-employee charges, and the tax is payable annually from January 1. A notarized S.A.V.E. affidavit and business registration documents are required.

items.title: File Clayton County business personal property return
items.description: Georgia business personal property returns (Form PT-50P) are due to the county between January 1 and April 1 for property held on January 1; a 10% penalty applies to unreported property if the return is late. A county notice says returns are filed with the Tax Commissioner's office.

note: Clayton County reportedly levies an 8% hotel-motel excise tax (monthly by the 20th) and requires a county business license in unincorporated areas, but only third-party summaries were found, not the county's own pages.

items.title: File Cobb County business personal property return
items.authority: Cobb County Board of Tax Assessors
items.description: Georgia business personal property returns (Form PT-50P) are due to the county between January 1 and April 1 for property held on January 1; a 10% penalty applies to unreported property if the return is late.

items.title: File the Cobb County hotel/motel excise tax report
items.description: The Hotel/Motel Occupancy Excise Tax Report is due between the 1st and 20th of the month after the reporting period, with payment by check to the division's Hotel Tax address (form dated 2018; confirm it is current).

appliesWhen.description: Operates a hotel, motel or short-term rental

note: Cobb's occupation tax certificate (expires December 31) is issued by the county for unincorporated Cobb; its fee and renewal date were not confirmed.

items.title: File DeKalb County business personal property return
items.description: Georgia business personal property returns (Form PT-50P) are due to the county between January 1 and April 1 for property held on January 1; a 10% penalty applies to unreported property if the return is late. Returns must be postmarked by midnight April 1; late filers risk penalties and loss of depreciation and exemptions. The county mails forms as a courtesy.

items.title: Obtain or renew the DeKalb County business license
items.description: DeKalb County's business tax has an administrative fee ($75 in the forms found), a minimum gross receipts tax ($50), tax on gross receipts over $20,000 and a per-employee fee; these amounts are from 2020 to 2023 county forms and may have changed. Transferring a business ends the license and starts a new one. Lodging operators also report hotel/motel excise tax on a separate excise account.

items.title: File Forsyth County business personal property return
items.description: Georgia business personal property returns (Form PT-50P) are due to the county between January 1 and April 1 for property held on January 1; a 10% penalty applies to unreported property if the return is late. The county allows no extensions and does not accept metered mail dates unless counter-stamped by the post office.

items.title: Obtain or renew the Forsyth County occupational tax certificate
items.description: All businesses operating in unincorporated Forsyth County must hold a current occupational tax certificate (business license), renewed annually. New businesses must apply within 30 days of starting and need a Business Location Verification Decision Letter from the county's CSS portal; applications are by mail or in person, not email.

items.title: File Fulton County business personal property return
items.description: Georgia business personal property returns (Form PT-50P) are due to the county by April 1; late returns carry a 10% penalty.

items.title: Renew the Fulton County business occupational tax certificate
items.description: Fulton County licenses only businesses in the Fulton Industrial District (unincorporated); all other Fulton businesses are licensed by their city. The certificate is valid for a calendar year and must be renewed by March 31.

items.title: File Gwinnett County business personal property return
items.description: Georgia business personal property returns (Form PT-50P) are due to the county by April 1; late returns carry a 10% penalty. Returns must be postmarked by April 1; email, fax and metered mail are not accepted as proof.

items.title: File Henry County business personal property return
items.description: Georgia business personal property returns (Form PT-50P) are due to the county between January 1 and April 1 for property held on January 1; a 10% penalty applies to unreported property if the return is late.

note: Henry County's occupation tax certificate and any lodging excise tax could not be confirmed from county pages.
